anchor.semantic_hook: Paying the customs duty is staged as a physical payment at a border inspection counter.
anchor.setting: A border customs hall contains an inspection counter, a baggage bench, storage racks, and a payment tray beside a raised barrier. An enormous coin carved from solid stone must be pushed across the tray before the barrier can open. The stone customs coin is the only surreal element.
anchor.absurd_element: an enormous solid-stone customs coin that must be paid at the barrier

inserts.action: slumps over a laptop at the inspection counter, eyes exhausted, while straining to push the stone customs coin toward the payment tray

variations.scene_adjust: a crowded work desk, many drained coffee cups, and an untouched pillow occupy the baggage bench

inserts.action: stands in muddy football gear with shaking legs and bowed shoulders, unable to lift the stone customs coin after the match

variations.scene_adjust: unused training cones and dusty exercise equipment fill the storage racks beside a scuffed football

inserts.action: kneels anxiously beside several heat-weakened animals on the inspection bench and braces both hands against the stone customs coin

variations.scene_adjust: a panting fox, a dehydrated seabird, brittle leaves, and a shallow dry water bowl cover the inspection area

inserts.action: points indignantly toward a broken vase left at the counter while the barrier forces him to shoulder the stone customs coin

variations.scene_adjust: a shattered vase and an abandoned glove lie on the far end of the counter, clearly beyond his belongings

inserts.action: stands as a weary small shopkeeper behind an empty till, turning out bare pockets before trying to roll the stone customs coin

variations.scene_adjust: nearly bare shop shelves, a closed cash drawer, and unsold goods occupy the storage side of the hall

inserts.action: clutches his stomach with one hand and strains with the other against the stone customs coin, his face pinched by poor health

variations.scene_adjust: an unbalanced meal of fried food and sweets crowds the baggage bench beside untouched vegetables and walking shoes

anchor.semantic_hook: An ambition without enough will or means is made visible as a grand destination with no reachable first step.
anchor.setting: A civic rehearsal hall has a broad practice floor, a movable worktable, storage cabinets, and a modest audience bench. At the far end, a monumental staircase rises toward a victory platform, but its entire lower flight is absent and the upper steps hang beyond anyone's reach. The unreachable staircase is the sole surreal feature.
anchor.absurd_element: a monumental staircase to success with its entire lower flight missing

variations.scene_adjust: a pristine easel, unopened paint tubes, and unused brushes stand on the practice floor

variations.scene_adjust: a toppled goal frame, discarded football boots, and a deflated ball occupy the practice floor after a loss

variations.scene_adjust: a plain trainee desk sits at floor level while an imposing director's chair waits on the victory platform

inserts.action: drops a single ballot token into a small box with a resigned shrug, glancing briefly toward the inaccessible platform

variations.scene_adjust: one small ballot box and a sparse row of empty folding chairs sit in the hall

inserts.action: sits casually on the practice floor strumming a guitar for pleasure, relaxed and content beneath the unreachable staircase

variations.scene_adjust: a guitar, two spare instruments on stands, and several informal floor cushions create a hobby rehearsal corner

anchor.semantic_hook: A fixed point is staged as one immovable point to which dependable parts of life can be secured.
